items.title: Target Names New CMO
items.summary: Continuing to build its comeback strategy, the retailer hires Mark Weinstein, Hilton's CMO, to fill the vacant role.

items.title: Kroger Q2 Earnings Beat on Cost Savings, Sales Outlook Cut
items.summary: Kroger beats Q2 earnings estimates as cost savings, pharmacy, fuel and e-commerce gains offset soft sales, while fiscal 2026 sales guidance is cut.

items.title: Can Macy's Raised 2026 Outlook Offset Third-Quarter Earnings Risk?
items.summary: M raises its 2026 outlook after stronger Q2 results, but heavier Q3 investment and soft earnings guidance keep near-term risks in focus.

items.title: Is Macy's Stock Cheap Enough to Buy Despite Uneven Second-Half Growth?
items.summary: M trades below industry and market valuations as stronger Q2 execution and raised guidance support the stock, despite soft second-half expectations.

items.title: Walmart Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates but Can Higher Costs Limit Upside?
items.summary: Walmart's Q2 beat, digital gains and raised outlook strengthen growth, but rising costs and heavier capex could limit near-term profit upside.

items.title: Target's Stores Power Its Expanding Omnichannel Fulfillment Network
items.summary: Target's stores fulfill 97.6% of merchandise sales in Q2 fiscal 2026 as digital sales and same-day delivery grow, reinforcing its omnichannel model.

items.title: Can Walmart's Expanding Delivery Network Strengthen Market Share?
items.summary: Walmart scales faster delivery, store-based fulfillment and new food occasions to deepen engagement and support market share gains.

items.title: Wizard Wellness Raises $1 Million, Unveils First Celebrity Campaign
items.summary: The next-gen allergy care brand, launched in January by beauty veteran Lorne Lucree, is in expansion mode.
